Given your appreciation for the soothing, improvisational nature of Ethiopian jazz, a gentle interruption might mirror that musicality – a thoughtful pause and then a smooth insertion of your thought. Think of it like a skilled musician weaving a new melodic line into an existing piece.

Instead of abruptly cutting off the speaker, try a phrase like, "That's a really interesting point, and it made me think of..." or "Building on what you're saying, I was just considering..." This acknowledges their contribution while signaling your desire to add to the conversation.
